label: committed a2 choice at GO (high-value a2 streak)
explanation: Update-gate unit that fires only before an a2 choice: essentially 100% of activations are on D1/GO steps of trials where the agent goes on to pick a2 (the agent own upcoming choice, which it computes; at GO this matches model_act==2 / very negative choice logit). It never fires at D2 or on a1 trials. 84% of mass is at GO, 16% at D1. Among a2 GO steps it fires mainly when the model value is high (>7.73, top value bins) and in mid-episode trials 10-59 (silent after trial ~90), and more in episodes where S2 is good. The largest activations are at D1 after an unrewarded trial inside an a2 streak, i.e. while the agent keeps its a2 commitment despite no reward. Recorded predicate GO & action==2 & value>7.73 (dev F1 0.60, mass recall 0.77); the broader (phase != D2) & action==2 has full recall but low precision (~0.2), so the unit marks a subset of a2 commitments that the listed variables only partly capture.
